source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The inspected shared runner has four assertions without a message argument: the migration-version threshold, window count, compose-window type and final collapsed-attribute comparison. The final comparison is the call updated to execute_async_script. A separate stored-value comparison supplies a context label but does not name the expected behavior. This identifies the exact touched runner's diagnostics under the current assertion-message requirement; it does not make historical code a style rule or treat a missing should word alone as a defect.
title: The toolbar migration runner retains four assertions without messages
